title: City of Clarkesville, Georgia, says a ransomware attack impacted some city computer systems
date_note: WSB-TV (26 November) says the city announced the attack on Wednesday, the day before Thanksgiving; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: WSB-TV names the City of Clarkesville, Georgia; coordinates are the city's
summary: According to WSB-TV, the City of Clarkesville announced on Wednesday, the day before Thanksgiving, that a ransomware attack had impacted some city computer systems. The city says it responded immediately, engaged cybersecurity professionals and notified law enforcement. WSB-TV reports the city is investigating with those partners and legal counsel.
plain: The city of Clarkesville, Georgia, says a ransomware attack affected some of its computer systems. It says it has brought in cybersecurity experts and told law enforcement.
exec: A US city government reports a ransomware attack on some of its systems and says it is investigating with outside experts, legal counsel and law enforcement.

validation.note: WSB-TV only, relaying the city's announcement; no city page and no second publisher found.
